column1: # navlistener reference-library fetch manifest — consumed by reference/Makefile.
# One row per redistributably-or-locally vendored ICD. Tab-separated. '#' = comment.
#   commit — redistribution permitted by the document's own terms; tracked in git
#            (see the negation list in .gitignore) and present on a fresh clone.
#   local  — terms grant no redistribution (or forbid it, or are uncleared); git-ignored,
#            NOT in a fresh clone. `make -C reference update` fetches it from the URL below
#            so a developer's machine matches the team byte-for-byte (verified by sha256).
# sha256 is the authority: `make verify` fails if a fetched/present file does not match,
# which is exactly how you detect an upstream re-publish (a new edition = a new row/hash).
# ---- GPS (U.S. Space Force via USCG NAVCEN) — public domain, Distribution Statement A ----
# ---- Galileo / EGNOS (EUSPA via GSC) — conditional © European Union grant (terms travel with the doc) ----
# ---- QZSS (Cabinet Office, Japan) — DCR has an explicit redistribution clause; PNT/L1S/L6 grant use only ----
# ---- NavIC / IRNSS (ISRO) — L5S forbids reproduction; L1 grants conditional non-profit reuse (held local by decision) ----
# ---- IGS/RTCM open format standards — files.igs.org, no © asserted. RINEX 3.05 + SP3-d back gnss/truth_test.go ----
# ---- GLONASS (Russia) — no redistribution grant; local only. GLO-ICD-5.1 URL is the UNB academic ----
# ---- mirror (byte-identical to the RISDE 2008 original); russianspacesystems.ru serves it behind a ----
# ---- Russian-government CA the default trust store rejects (see REFERENCES.md, GLO-CDMA rows). ----
# ---- BeiDou (China Satellite Navigation Office) — CSNO reserves interpretation; no redistribution grant; local only ----
